prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and endurance for competitive cycling

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and includes snacks appropriate for athletic performance
All meals and snacks are vegan and gluten-free with no restricted ingredients
Provides adequate protein and carbohydrates to support muscle building and endurance training
task_description: Write a compact and concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with an athlete having multiple dietary restrictions (vegan + gluten-free) while maintaining athletic performance nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle recovery and protein intake for strength training

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals and includes protein-rich options at each meal
Total daily protein intake meets or exceeds 185g (1g per lb bodyweight)
Includes specific meal timing recommendations for pre/post-workout nutrition
Plan is concise and formatted as a single-day schedule
task_description: Write a compact and concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) prioritizing protein intake and muscle recovery nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - carbohydrate loading for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and includes snacks appropriate for an endurance athlete
Emphasizes carbohydrate-rich foods (55-65% of calories) to support marathon training
Provides approximately 3,500-4,000 calories total, suitable for a 165-lb marathon runner
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-read format with meal times and food items clearly listed
task_description: Write a compact and concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with a endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading focus

prompt_inputs.goal: maintain weight while staying energized for wrestling training in the 149-pound weight class
prompt_inputs.restrictions: no dairy due to lactose intolerance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,400-2,600 calories (maintenance for 147 lb athlete)
Includes at least 120g protein distributed across meals for muscle recovery
Provides nutrient-dense, whole foods suitable for weight-class sport
task_description: Write a compact and concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with a sport with strict weight class requirements (boxer or wrestler) needing calorie-controlled but nutrient-dense meals

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery on competition day

solution_criteria: Includes pre-event, during-event, and post-event meals with appropriate timing
Meal composition aligns with competition day nutritional needs (carbs for energy, protein for recovery)
All meals respect lactose intolerance and nut-free restrictions
Plan is compact and fits within a single day format
task_description: Write a compact and concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with an athlete in active competition day scenario requiring pre-event, during-event, and post-event meal timing and composition
